testator.zh: **立遗嘱人**(testator)即立**遗嘱**(will)者，可"身后"掌控财产归属，否则由州决定。

intestate succession.s: Many of the problems common to intestate succession rear their heads here.
intestate succession.zh: **无遗嘱继承**(intestate succession)的常见难题在此重现：你或愿挚友而非年迈父母、不肖手足抚养子女，法律却优先亲属。

escheat.s: If there are no heirs, then the property will escheat to the state.

intestacy.s: In the latter instance, the state will allocate the property in compliance with the intestacy statute.
intestacy.zh: 后者由州依**无遗嘱继承法**(intestacy statute)分配财产。

holographic will.s: A holographic will is one written entirely in the testator's handwriting and signed by him or her.
holographic will.zh: **自书遗嘱**(holographic will)由**立遗嘱人**(testator)全文手书并签名。

nuncupative will.s: Not all states accept holographic and nuncupative wills, and, as previously noted, the validity of the will is determined by the laws of the domicile of the testator.
nuncupative will.zh: **口述遗嘱**(nuncupative will)成文法通常设严格生效要件，如：(1)**立遗嘱人**(testator)知死亡将至；(2)证人不得依该**遗嘱**(will)取利；(3)只**动产**(personalty)（现金汽车等）不涉**不动产**(realty)**所有权**(title)，如克斯蒂的**口述遗嘱**(nuncupative will)可传耐克鞋收藏，不传牧场。

testamentary capacity.s: The testamentary capacity needed to make a will is not tantamount to the legal ability to contract.
testamentary capacity.zh: 立任何**遗嘱**(will)的**立遗嘱人**(testator)须有**遗嘱能力**(testamentary capacity)，即**神志健全**(sound mind)，懂得"财产之性质范围、受恩自然对象、所作财产处分"及三者关联。

codicil.s: One method of changing one's will is to add a codicil, a formal modification or addition to the existing instrument.
codicil.zh: 一法是加**遗嘱补正书**(codicil)，正式修改增补原**遗嘱**(will)；二法是立新**遗嘱**(will)，以新文措辞撤销旧**遗嘱**(will)，最好销毁原件，双管齐下。

living will.s: A corollary issue is that of the "living will" that allows you and your family freedom of choice in regard to medical treatment for the terminally ill.
living will.zh: 联邦立法要求收联邦医保医助款的医院（几乎全部）告知患者拒疗权，查患者有无**生前遗嘱**(living will)或持久医疗**授权书**(power of attorney)并入档。

probate.s: Again, this is not the ideal time to employ self-help methods or to ignore probate if one wishes to have legal title to any property one inherits.
probate.zh: 有**遗嘱**(will)指定**遗嘱执行人**(executor)或**遗产管理人**(administrator)的，**遗嘱检验**(probate)一般简廉得多，否则法院指定人选。

administrator.s: Parole is both granted and revoked by administrators rather than by judges.
administrator.zh: 假释由行政官员而非法官决定给予或撤销。

trust.s: Fee tails are disfavored by the law, and many courts will dissolve the fee tail so that land may be transferred and then create an equitable trust from the proceeds from the sale.
trust.zh: 法律厌恶**限嗣继承地产权**(fee tail)，许多法院会解除之使土地可转，再以售款设**衡平信托**(equitable trust)。

trustor.s: Trustors have been quite creative in the restrictions and control they have exerted.
trustor.zh: **委托人**(trustor)在限制与控制上创意无穷。

settlor.s: Trusts may be either created in a will––a testamentary trust––or during the lifetime of the settlor––an inter vivos trust.
settlor.zh: **信托**(trust)可立于**遗嘱**(will)（**遗嘱信托**(testamentary trust)），可立于**委托人**(settlor)生前（**生前信托**(inter vivos trust)）。

testamentary trust.s: Trusts may be either created in a will––a testamentary trust––or during the lifetime of the settlor––an inter vivos trust.
testamentary trust.zh: **信托**(trust)可立于**遗嘱**(will)（**遗嘱信托**(testamentary trust)），可立于**委托人**(settlor)生前（**生前信托**(inter vivos trust)）。

inter vivos trust.s: Trusts may be either created in a will––a testamentary trust––or during the lifetime of the settlor––an inter vivos trust.
inter vivos trust.zh: **信托**(trust)可立于**遗嘱**(will)（**遗嘱信托**(testamentary trust)），可立于**委托人**(settlor)生前（**生前信托**(inter vivos trust)）。

rule against perpetuities.s: This is known as the Rule Against Perpetuities.
rule against perpetuities.zh: **信托**(trust)条款可量身定制；虽可"身后"长控，但**信托**(trust)终须终止，不得超过创设时在世指定者亡后21年，是为**反永久管业规则**(rule against perpetuities)。

corpus.s: The trustee has the responsibility to manage the trust assets, protect the corpus, and comply with the directions of the trust instrument.
corpus.zh: **受托人**(trustee)负责管**信托**(trust)资产、护**本金**(corpus)、遵**信托**(trust)文书指示，可为自然人，也可为银行、信托公司等公司。

principal.s: Now all three are classified as principals and possess the same degree of culpability.
principal.zh: **普通法**(common law)制度下，**从犯**(accessory)一般须等到某一**主犯**(principal)被定罪后才能被追诉。

donee.s: The donee receives full legal title to the property and has full management of it.
donee.zh: **赠与**(gift)对**受赠人**(donee)免税：巨额**赠与**(gift)予个人慈善，暖人心亦节税（慈善捐税惠有限）。

intellectual property.s: However, as stated earlier, one of the first major pieces of legislation passed by Congress dealt with the issues of intellectual property despite this hostility.
intellectual property.zh: 但如前述，国会首批大法之一即涉**知识产权**(intellectual property)，不顾敌意。

license.s: The issue became moot once the U.S. Supreme Court ruled in Obergefell v. Hodges, 576 U.S. ______ (2015) that states may not refuse to issue licenses to same-sex couples.
license.zh: 得州埃尔帕索县书记员曾遇到难题：两名明显为女性的申请人申请**结婚许可**(marriage license)。

trademark.s: The holder of the trademark has the burden to prosecute any infringement and may obtain injunctive relief as well as damages.
trademark.zh: **商标**(trademark)持有人负追诉**侵权**(infringement)之责，可获禁令救济与**损害赔偿**(damages)。

unfair competition.s: Intellectual property also encompasses the notion of "unfair competition" under both the common law and the Lanham Act, 15 U.S.C.A. §§ 1051–1127.
unfair competition.zh: **知识产权**(intellectual property)还含**普通法**(common law)与《**兰哈姆法**(lanham act)》(15 U.S.C.A. §§ 1051–1127）下的**不正当竞争**(unfair competition)。

prior art.s: The invention also must not be wholly anticipated by the so-called "prior art" or public domain materials such as publications and other patents.
prior art.zh: 能最低限度用于实用目的即有用；不得被**现有技术**(prior art)即出版物他**专利**(patent)等公有材料完全预见；超本领域熟练工匠通常能力即合**非显而易见性**(non-obviousness)之求。

non-obviousness.s: The non-obviousness requirement is met if the invention is beyond the ordinary abilities of a skilled artisan knowledgeable in the appropriate field.
non-obviousness.zh: 能最低限度用于实用目的即有用；不得被**现有技术**(prior art)即出版物他**专利**(patent)等公有材料完全预见；超本领域熟练工匠通常能力即合**非显而易见性**(non-obviousness)之求。

design patent.s: Design patents are those protecting ornamental features on some manufactured article (e.g., the swoosh on Nike shoes) rather than function.
design patent.zh: **外观设计专利**(design patent)护制成品装饰特征（如耐克鞋对勾）而非功能。

plant patent.s: Plant patents are those dealing with the asexual reproduction of new and distinct plants through grafting, budding, or similar techniques.
plant patent.zh: **植物专利**(plant patent)涉嫁接、芽接等无性繁殖的新异植物。

patent and trademark office.s: Applications for patents are made to the Patent and Trademark Office, and the processing of such patents is often arduous, time consuming, and expensive.
patent and trademark office.zh: **专利**(patent)向**专利商标局**(patent and trademark office)申请，程序艰耗时费。

court of appeals for the federal circuit.s: Appeal is to the Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit, subject to infrequent granting of review by the Supreme Court.
court of appeals for the federal circuit.zh: 上诉归**联邦巡回上诉法院**(court of appeals for the federal circuit)，最高法院极少复审。

infringement.s: A second challenge is rulings by courts, including the U.S. Supreme Court, that states are essentially immune from patent infringement lawsuits.
infringement.zh: 其二是法院（含最高法院）判州基本豁免**专利**(patent)**侵权**(infringement)诉，¹⁰⁷寒彻**知识产权**(intellectual property)界。

fair use.s: However, copying the same material is not necessarily barred because of the fair use doctrine.
fair use.zh: 该法禁**规避**(circumvent)防未授权接触的技术；但因**合理使用**(fair use)原则，复制不一定禁。

trade secret.s: Protection of trade secrets originated under the common law and is governed primarily by state law, although federal copyright law may also be involved.
trade secret.zh: **商业秘密**(trade secret)保护源于**普通法**(common law)，主由州法管，联邦**版权**(copyright)法亦可涉。

lanham act.s: Intellectual property also encompasses the notion of "unfair competition" under both the common law and the Lanham Act, 15 U.S.C.A. §§ 1051–1127.
lanham act.zh: **知识产权**(intellectual property)还含**普通法**(common law)与《**兰哈姆法**(lanham act)》(15 U.S.C.A. §§ 1051–1127）下的**不正当竞争**(unfair competition)。

right of publicity.s: This right of publicity obviously survives the death of the individual, while the tort right to privacy does not.
right of publicity.zh: 此**公开权**(right of publicity)显然死后存续，**侵权行为**(tort)**隐私权**(right to privacy)则否。

lawsuit.s: Tort law deals with injuries sustained by individuals and with their lawsuits against those who injure them.
lawsuit.zh: **侵权法**(tort law)处理个人所受伤害及对加害人的诉讼。

felony.s: District courts may have the prerequisites of jurisdiction to hear felony cases, but the venue statute will limit the venue to the county in which the crime occurred.
felony.zh: 地区法院可能具备审理**重罪**(felony)案件的管辖（jurisdiction）要件，但**审判地制定法**(venue statute)将**审判地**(venue)限定在犯罪发生的县。

dissolution.s: The courts are there only to resolve the legal issues of dissolution, property, custody, and support in accordance with the statutes and legal precepts.
dissolution.zh: 法院只按**制定法**(statute)与**法律准则**(legal precept)解决**解除**(dissolution)、**财产**(property)、**监护权**(custody)与**扶养**(support)的法律问题。

marriage.s: Marriage is a legal status founded on contract law in American jurisprudence.
marriage.zh: 若**婚姻关系**(marital relationship)的创设符合当地要求，又不违反他州强烈的**公共政策**(public policy)，则在全美有效。

custody.s: A court must have jurisdiction to grant a divorce, to enter a property settlement, and to decide custody of the couple's children.
custody.zh: 法院须有**司法管辖权**(jurisdiction)才能准予**离婚**(divorce)、作出**财产分割**(property division)并裁定子女**监护权**(custody)。

paternity suit.s: The crucial factor in many paternity suits is the result of sophisticated genetic tests, including DNA.
paternity suit.zh: **确认生父之诉**(paternity suit)与其他**诉讼**(lawsuit)一样，须向推定父亲充分**通知**(notice)并给其抗辩机会。

adoption.s: It voids the original legal relationship, and in adoption cases the court records are sealed and new birth certificates may be issued.
adoption.zh: 它使原法律关系归于**无效**(void)，**收养**(adoption)案件中法院卷宗密封，可签发新的**出生证明**(birth certificate)。

spouse.s: Spouses may try to disclaim intent in a divorce suit in order to avoid a property settlement, but the requisite intent may be shown indirectly by other evidence.
spouse.zh: **配偶**(spouse)一方可能在**离婚诉讼**(divorce suit)中否认**合意**(mutual assent)以逃避**财产分割**(property division)，但必要**合意**(mutual assent)可用其他证据间接**证明**(proof)。

state legislature.s: State legislatures and courts bear the primary onus of dealing with the sometimes complex, often time-consuming issues of family law.
state legislature.zh: **州立法机关**(state legislature)与法院承担着处理**家庭法**(family law)这些有时复杂、常常耗时的问题的主要重任。

supreme court.s: Some constitutional law scholars and Supreme Court justices have advocated a middle-tier approach to equal protection analysis.
supreme court.zh: 一些宪法学者和**最高法院**(supreme court)大法官主张**平等保护**(equal protection)分析的中间层方法，允许法官在疑难案件用高于合理依据、低于**严格审查**(strict scrutiny)的审查。

equal protection.s: Some constitutional law scholars and Supreme Court justices have advocated a middle-tier approach to equal protection analysis.
equal protection.zh: 一些宪法学者和**最高法院**(supreme court)大法官主张**平等保护**(equal protection)分析的中间层方法，允许法官在疑难案件用高于合理依据、低于**严格审查**(strict scrutiny)的审查。

state court.s: It is state courts––often specially created domestic-relation courts––that try and then decide the overwhelming majority of such cases.
state court.zh: 审理并裁判绝大多数这类案件的，是**州法院**(state court)——常常是专门设立的**家事法院**(domestic-relation court)。

domestic-relation court.s: It is state courts––often specially created domestic-relation courts––that try and then decide the overwhelming majority of such cases.
domestic-relation court.zh: 审理并裁判绝大多数这类案件的，是**州法院**(state court)——常常是专门设立的**家事法院**(domestic-relation court)。

jurisprudence.s: Central to takings jurisprudence is the "bundle of rights" concept inherent in ownership of property.
jurisprudence.zh: **征收**(takings)法理的核心是财产所有权内含的“**一束权利**(bundle of rights)”概念：财产附带一束不同的权利，其中部分可被政府行为减损，其余仍归所有人。

litigant.s: Although lawyers are allowed to appear in JP courts in most states, the litigants often just represent themselves and let the judge decide the case without a jury.
litigant.zh: 虽然大多数州允许律师出庭，但**诉讼当事人**(litigants)常亲自出庭，由法官无陪审团断案。

informal marriage.s: Informal marriages are sometimes called "common law marriages," a term that may refer to their non-statutory origin.
informal marriage.zh: 各州都有**正式婚姻**(formal marriage)的标准，只有少数州规定了**非正式婚姻**(informal marriage)，**婚姻**(marriage)效力依**地方性法律**(local law)判定。

maintenance.s: Such maintenance orders are entered by the court after adequate notice and the opportunity for a hearing on the matter.
maintenance.zh: 决定**离婚**(divorce)后，**州立法机关**(state legislature)常授权在**离婚**(divorce)系属期间向有需要一方发放临时**配偶扶养费**(spousal support)或**生活费**(maintenance)。

formal.s: The first formal requirements for obtaining a divorce occurred during the reign of Augustus Caesar in 40 CE.
formal.zh: 对**离婚**(divorce)设置**正式**(formal)要件，始于公元40年奥古斯都·凯撒统治时期。

ground.s: The other alternative, available after 1660, was divorce by special parliamentary act on the grounds of adultery.
ground.zh: 另一选择出现于一六六〇年后，即以通奸为由经议会特别法案离婚。

no-fault.s: The adoption of no-fault grounds both facilitates obtaining a divorce and reduces the involvement of the judicial system to a minimum.
no-fault.zh: 采用**无过错**(no-fault)**理由**(ground)既便利**离婚**(divorce)，又把**司法系统**(judicial system)的介入降到最低。

fault.s: One reason to allege fault in a divorce petition or to prove fault at trial is to affect child custody or the property division against the wrongdoer.
fault.zh: 在**离婚诉状**(divorce petition)中主张**过错**(fault)或在**审判**(trial)中**证明**(proof)**过错**(fault)，目的之一是让子女**监护权**(custody)或**财产分割**(property division)对**过错方**(at-fault party)不利。

property division.s: One reason to allege fault in a divorce petition or to prove fault at trial is to affect child custody or the property division against the wrongdoer.
property division.zh: 在**离婚诉状**(divorce petition)中主张**过错**(fault)或在**审判**(trial)中**证明**(proof)**过错**(fault)，目的之一是让子女**监护权**(custody)或**财产分割**(property division)对**过错方**(at-fault party)不利。

praetor.s: If fault was involved, then the innocent party was favored in the property settlement, and the case was heard by one of the praetors.
praetor.zh: 若涉及**过错**(fault)，无过错一方在**财产分割**(property division)中受优待，案件由**裁判官**(praetor)之一审理。

justiciable.s: For a time, there was complete freedom in matters of marriage and divorce, and they were not justiciable matters unless there was controversy over the property settlement.
justiciable.zh: 曾有一段时间，**婚姻**(marriage)与**离婚**(divorce)完全自由，除非**财产分割**(property division)发生争议，否则不属于**可裁判**(justiciable)事项。

code.s: In civil law countries the law is extensively codified, and decisions are based on the code as designed by the legislature rather than on binding judicial precedent.
code.zh: 在**大陆法系**(civil law)国家，法律被广泛法典化，裁判依据立法者设计的**法典**(code)而非有约束力的司法**先例**(precedent)。

canon law.s: The latter enforced canon law as handed down by the Catholic Church and had sole jurisdiction over matters of marital relationships and inheritance.
canon law.zh: 后者执行天主教会传下的**教会法**(canon law)，对婚姻**继承**(inheritance)事项有专属**管辖权**(jurisdiction)。

ecclesiastical court.s: By the end of the thirteenth century, there were three law courts in the secular realm and a firmly entrenched system of ecclesiastical courts.
ecclesiastical court.zh: **教会法院**(ecclesiastical courts)对婚姻的支配延续到十九世纪中叶，尽管天主教会已被英国国教会取代。

jurisdiction.s: A court must have jurisdiction to grant a divorce, to enter a property settlement, and to decide custody of the couple's children.
jurisdiction.zh: 法院须有**司法管辖权**(jurisdiction)才能准予**离婚**(divorce)、作出**财产分割**(property division)并裁定子女**监护权**(custody)。

chattel.s: The wife was essentially a chattel, and her property rights were not protected until the equity courts interceded, beginning in the seventeenth century.
chattel.zh: 妻子实质上形同**动产**(chattel)，其**财产权**(property right)直到十七世纪**衡平法院**(equity court)介入才得到保护。

property right.s: In upholding the constitutionality of zoning ordinances, the Supreme Court sent a clear message that individual property rights must sometimes give way to the public good.
property right.zh: 最高法院维持分区条例的合宪性，明确传递了个人财产权有时须让位于公共利益的信息，并裁定此类财产使用限制是州**治安权**(police power)的正当行使，不构成第五修正案下的**征收**(taking)。

equity court.s: The wife was essentially a chattel, and her property rights were not protected until the equity courts interceded, beginning in the seventeenth century.
equity court.zh: 妻子实质上形同**动产**(chattel)，其**财产权**(property right)直到十七世纪**衡平法院**(equity court)介入才得到保护。

consanguinity.s: Laws also prohibit marriage between those who are related within certain degrees of consanguinity and of affinity.
consanguinity.zh: 法律还禁止一定**血亲关系**(consanguinity)与**姻亲关系**(affinity)内的通婚，即不得与父母、兄弟姐妹（同父同母与同父异母或同母异父均包括在内）、子女及其他晚辈直系亲属、祖父母或曾祖父母等直系尊亲属结婚。

marital relationship.s: The prevalent method for terminating a marital relationship is divorce.
marital relationship.zh: 终止**婚姻关系**(marital relationship)最常用的方式是**离婚**(divorce)。

territory.s: In the settlements, there was increased emphasis on the individual, because of both religious beliefs and the need to be self-sufficient in opening up new territory.
territory.zh: 在殖民定居点，人们更强调个人，这既源于宗教信仰，也源于开拓新领地时自给自足的需要。

domestic relations law.s: Domestic relations law touches every American because it deals with family issues.
domestic relations law.zh: **家事法**(domestic relations law)关乎家庭，触及每个美国人。

polygamy.s: In addition to the polygamy issue, religious groups have sought exemptions from general laws in a variety of other cases.
polygamy.zh: 除多配偶制问题外，宗教团体还在其他各类案件中寻求一般法律的豁免。

divorce suit.s: Spouses may try to disclaim intent in a divorce suit in order to avoid a property settlement, but the requisite intent may be shown indirectly by other evidence.
divorce suit.zh: **配偶**(spouse)一方可能在**离婚诉讼**(divorce suit)中否认**合意**(mutual assent)以逃避**财产分割**(property division)，但必要**合意**(mutual assent)可用其他证据间接**证明**(proof)。

proof.s: The practice of claiming fault as a ground for divorce has fallen into disfavor because of the problems of proof.
proof.zh: 以**过错**(fault)为**离婚**(divorce)**理由**(ground)的做法因**证明**(proof)难题已失宠。

irreconcilable differences.s: Mental cruelty, adultery, irreconcilable differences, and incompatibility are common substantive grounds for a divorce.
irreconcilable differences.zh: 精神虐待、**通奸**(adultery)、不可调和的分歧和性格不合，都是常见的离婚实体法事由。

incompatibility.s: Mental cruelty, adultery, irreconcilable differences, and incompatibility are common substantive grounds for a divorce.
incompatibility.zh: 精神虐待、**通奸**(adultery)、不可调和的分歧和性格不合，都是常见的离婚实体法事由。

mediation.s: Mediation is also employed in minor criminal actions.
mediation.zh: 但中国旧法理中保留并纳入社会主义制度的一面是**调解**(mediation)。

status.s: Marriage is a legal status founded on contract law in American jurisprudence.
status.zh: 在美国**法理**(jurisprudence)中，**婚姻**(marriage)是以**合同法**(contract law)为基础的法律**身份**(status)。

public policy.s: A Supreme Court justice is in a position to influence public policy in America for many years; the nominee must therefore be chosen carefully.
public policy.zh: 大法官多年影响美国公共政策，人选须慎之又慎。

tax law.s: Tax law is frequently cited as an example of how laws are written to benefit a particular economic class.
tax law.zh: **税法**(tax law)常被引为法律为特定**经济阶层**(economic class)谋利的例证。

abortion.s: As noted in Chapter 6, the issues of same-sex marriage, abortion, gun control, and capital punishment are perennial issues before the courts of the nation.
abortion.zh: 正如第六章所述，**同性婚姻**(same-sex marriage)、**堕胎**(abortion)、**枪支管制**(gun control)与**死刑**(capital punishment)是全国法院经久不衰的议题。

common law marriage.s: Informal marriages are sometimes called "common law marriages," a term that may refer to their non-statutory origin.
common law marriage.zh: **非正式婚姻**(informal marriage)有时称“**普通法婚姻**(common law marriage)”，该词或指其非制定法起源。

local law.s: In determining the validity of the marriage, it is critical to examine the local laws of the jurisdiction in which the marriage occurred.
local law.zh: 判断**婚姻**(marriage)效力，关键看**婚姻**(marriage)举行地**司法辖区**(jurisdiction)的**地方性法律**(local law)。

federal government.s: About half of the states and the federal government have indictment by grand jury.
federal government.zh: 约半数州和联邦政府实行**大陪审团起诉**(indictment by grand jury)。

legislature.s: State legislatures and courts bear the primary onus of dealing with the sometimes complex, often time-consuming issues of family law.
legislature.zh: **州立法机关**(state legislature)与法院承担着处理**家庭法**(family law)这些有时复杂、常常耗时的问题的主要重任。

same-sex marriage.s: The case reached the Court because of split decision of the circuit courts of appeals as to the constitutionality of state bans against same-sex marriage.
same-sex marriage.zh: 案件到达**最高法院**(supreme court)，是因为巡回上诉法院对州**同性婚姻**(same-sex marriage)**禁令**(injunction)的**合宪性**(constitutionality)存在分歧。

affinity.s: Laws also prohibit marriage between those who are related within certain degrees of consanguinity and of affinity.
affinity.zh: 法律还禁止一定**血亲关系**(consanguinity)与**姻亲关系**(affinity)内的通婚，即不得与父母、兄弟姐妹（同父同母与同父异母或同母异父均包括在内）、子女及其他晚辈直系亲属、祖父母或曾祖父母等直系尊亲属结婚。

partner.s: In addition, the couples typically affirmed that they were responsible for the welfare of each other and that they were the sole domestic partner of the other.
partner.zh: 这些**制定法**(statute)常同时适用于同性与异性**伴侣**(partner)，一般要求**当事人**(party)年满18岁、共**同居**(cohabitation)住、有**缔约能力**(capacity to contract)、不违反州反**乱伦法**(incest statute)，关系方可**正式**(formal)**登记**(register)。

marriage license.s: Most citizens accept the necessity of meeting certain statutory requirements, such as those of obtaining a marriage license and attending school.
marriage license.zh: 多数公民接受满足某些法定要求的必要，如申领**结婚许可证**(marriage license)、入学。

state constitution.s: Cases involving the state’s criminal laws, civil code, or state constitution fall within the judicial power of the state.
state constitution.zh: 一般管辖权法院有权审理落入州**一般司法权**(general judicial power)范围的任何案件，即有权对依州宪法和法律可司法解决的案件作出**裁断**(verdict)。

trial court.s: The U.S. district courts, the main trial courts for the United States, have both criminal and civil jurisdiction.
trial court.zh: 地区法院是美国主要的**初审法院**(trial courts)，兼有**刑事管辖权**(criminal jurisdiction)和**民事管辖权**(civil jurisdiction)。

defendant.s: If it is clear that the defendant’s negligence caused the injury, the judge will grant the plaintiff’s motion.
defendant.zh: 若**被告**(defendant)**过失**(negligence)致伤明确，法官准其动议；但多数案件中**被告**(defendant)**过失**(negligence)并不分明，**原告**(plaintiff)动议被驳回。

fundamental right.s: In addition, if the state can demonstrate that the law is carefully tailored to minimize the burden on a fundamental right, the statute may be constitutional.
fundamental right.zh: 与**敏感分类**(suspect classification)一样，州证明制定法律有迫切利益即可正当化对**基本权利**(fundamental right)的侵犯。

constitutionality.s: The case reached the Court because of split decision of the circuit courts of appeals as to the constitutionality of state bans against same-sex marriage.
constitutionality.zh: 案件到达**最高法院**(supreme court)，是因为巡回上诉法院对州**同性婚姻**(same-sex marriage)**禁令**(injunction)的**合宪性**(constitutionality)存在分歧。

strict scrutiny.s: If the law involves a suspect class, a fundamental right, or both, the Court applies “strict scrutiny” to the law.
strict scrutiny.zh: 法律涉**敏感类别**(suspect class)、**基本权利**(fundamental right)或兼涉，法院用“**严格审查**(strict scrutiny)”。

remand.s: The court of appeals may order a new trial to be held or simply remand the case with orders to correct the lower court’s judgment.
remand.zh: **上诉人**(appellant)胜诉，初审判决通常有变：上诉法院可下令新审判，或把案**发回**(remand)令下级法院纠正判决。

equal protection clause.s: In determining whether the Equal Protection Clause has been violated, the Supreme Court has employed a two-tier approach.
equal protection clause.zh: 判定是否违反**平等保护条款**(equal protection clause)，**最高法院**(supreme court)用双层方法。

marital status.s: Habib A. Balian, "Till Death Do Us Part: Granting Full Faith and Credit to Marital Status," 68 S. Cal.
marital status.zh: 32. 中文：哈比卜·A. 巴利安，《至死方休：给予**婚姻身份**(marital status)充分信任与尊重》，《南加州法律评论》第68卷（1995年）第397页。

standard of review.s: The Court is continually examining methods of streamlining the appeals process while maintaining a strict standard of review.
standard of review.zh: 法院不断探索在维持严格审查标准下简化**上诉**(appeal)程序。

appeal.s: Rummel was paroled just eight months after his appeal was denied by the Supreme Court, [169] and Williams was sentenced to life in prison.
appeal.zh: 某种意义上两案正义都实现：拉梅尔上诉被最高法院驳回仅八个月即假释[169]，威廉姆斯终身监禁。

constitutional amendment.s: In November 1880 the people of Kansas passed a constitutional amendment prohibiting the sale of alcoholic beverages in the state.
constitutional amendment.zh: 彼得·马格勒1877年在堪萨斯州萨利纳耗资一万美元建造啤酒厂；1880年11月堪萨斯州通过宪法修正案禁止在州内销售酒精饮料，马格勒因非法售酒被定罪并罚款100美元。

welfare.s: In addition, the couples typically affirmed that they were responsible for the welfare of each other and that they were the sole domestic partner of the other.
welfare.zh: 各**条例**(ordinance)提供的法律保护与**福利**(welfare)程度差异很大，但都给了**当事人**(party)关系被承认的心理慰藉。

plaintiff.s: If it is clear that the defendant’s negligence caused the injury, the judge will grant the plaintiff’s motion.
plaintiff.zh: 若**被告**(defendant)**过失**(negligence)致伤明确，法官准其动议；但多数案件中**被告**(defendant)**过失**(negligence)并不分明，**原告**(plaintiff)动议被驳回。

public health.s: States, realizing the public health costs of treating indigent and elderly victims of smoking-related diseases, have successfully sued tobacco companies.
public health.zh: 各州意识到救治吸烟相关疾病中的**贫困**(indigent)与老年**受害者**(victim)的**公共卫生**(public health)成本，转而成功起诉了烟草公司。

state government.s: There was widespread belief that another Due Process Clause was needed to protect the newly freed slaves from vindictive actions at the hands of southern state governments.
state government.zh: ”当时普遍认为，需要另一项**正当程序条款**(due process clause)保护新获自由的奴隶免受南方州政府的报复行为。

approval.s: After the newly appointed judge has served a probationary period of at least one year, he or she must go before the voters for their approval.
approval.zh: 新任命的法官在至少一年的试用期后，必须接受选民投票认可。

federal law.s: Public personas may also be protected by either state or federal law.
federal law.zh: 公众人物亦受州联邦法护：1962年去世的玛丽莲·梦露好莱坞传奇邮票印"版权所有。

possession.s: The primary right is to have physical possession of the child and to establish his or her legal domicile without interference by third parties.
possession.zh: 首要权利是实际占有子女，并在不受第三方干涉的情况下确定其法定住所。

tribe.s: Any restraints on antisocial behavior developed within tribes or within local areas, and most conflicts were resolved by violence.
tribe.zh: 对反社会行为的约束在部落或地方内形成，多数冲突靠暴力解决。

judicial action.s: Divorce by consent alone is not allowed in the United States, and some type of judicial action is necessary to dissolve marriages.
judicial action.zh: 美国不允许仅凭**合意**(mutual assent)**离婚**(divorce)，**解除**(dissolution)**婚姻**(marriage)须经某种**司法程序**(judicial action)。

state law.s: The court may consider these factors in dividing the property and in setting spousal support if permitted by state law.
state law.zh: 法院分割**财产**(property)、确定**配偶扶养费**(spousal support)（如**州法**(state law)允许）时可考虑这些因素。

civil union.s: Some states and local governments adopted various forms of civil unions.
civil union.zh: 一些州和地方政府采用了各种形式的**民事结合**(civil union)。

capacity to contract.s: The mental capacity to contract may be defined as the ability to understand the nature and effects of the business being transacted.
capacity to contract.zh: 缔约的精神能力可界定为理解所从事商事行为性质与后果的能力。

incest statute.s: In addition, some of the relationships will also fall afoul of such criminal laws as incest statutes.
incest statute.zh: 此外，有些关系还会触犯**乱伦法**(incest statute)等**刑法**(criminal law)。

register.s: Designation of the property on the National Register does make the owner eligible for federal grants-in-aid and loan guaranties as well as certain breaks on income tax.
register.zh: 财产列入国家登记名册，可使所有人有资格获得联邦补助金、贷款担保及一定的所得税减免。

domestic partner.s: In addition, the couples typically affirmed that they were responsible for the welfare of each other and that they were the sole domestic partner of the other.
domestic partner.zh: 30 在这些地方，**家庭伴侣**(domestic partner)**制定法**(statute)提供了“官方认可的郑重承诺关系的唯一方式”。

notice.s: Such maintenance orders are entered by the court after adequate notice and the opportunity for a hearing on the matter.
notice.zh: 这类**扶养命令**(support order)由法院在充分**通知**(notice)并**听证**(hearing)后作出。

federalism.s: It is equally clear that as we enter a third century of constitutional development the issue of federalism is not dead.
federalism.zh: 联邦管制州活动的争论显然进入新阶段；同样显然，进入宪政第三个世纪，**联邦制**(federalism)问题并未终结。

comity.s: Equity decrees apparently do not fall under the Full Faith and Credit Clause, but they may be recognized on a comity, or courtesy, basis.
comity.zh: **衡平法令**(equity decree)显然不属**充分信任和尊重条款**(full faith and credit clause)范围，但可基于**礼让**(comity)得到承认。

dissent.s: The four justices in the minority issued four dissents, each of which was joined by at least one other justice.
dissent.zh: 但**异议**(dissent)最猛烈的攻击针对法院充当超级立法者与政策制定者的角色：多数派越界了，颠覆了民主程序，这类事项应留给人民和各**州立法机关**(state legislature)。

federal district court.s: Currently, Congress has authorized 667 regular and ten temporary federal district court judges in the United States.
federal district court.zh: 如今50个州共有89家联邦地区法院，哥伦比亚特区、关岛、维尔京群岛、北马里亚纳群岛和波多黎各各一家，共94家联邦地区法院。

lead plaintiff.s: The lead plaintiff was James Obergefell who had married John Arthur in Maryland.
lead plaintiff.zh: **首席原告**(lead plaintiff)詹姆斯·奥贝格费尔在马里兰与约翰·阿瑟结婚。

death certificate.s: Similarly, David Michener filed a lawsuit when his spouse, William Ives, died suddenly, and Michener could not be listed on the death certificate as spouse.
death certificate.zh: 阿瑟身患肌萎缩侧索硬化症(als)晚期，希望奥贝格费尔作为**配偶**(spouse)列入其**死亡证明**(death certificate)，以便死后葬入阿瑟家族墓地；除非奥贝格费尔是**配偶**(spouse)，或所有可能对墓地享有利益的家人同意，否则无法如愿。

state attorney general.s: Based on their Maryland marriage, the Ohio Registrar agreed to the listing, but the state attorney general's office chose to intervene and defend the state's same-sex marriage ban.
state attorney general.zh: 俄亥俄州**登记官**(registrar)依据二人的马里兰**婚姻**(marriage)同意**登记**(register)，但**州检察长**(state attorney general)办公室选择介入，为州**同性婚姻**(same-sex marriage)**禁令**(injunction)辩护。

birth certificate.s: It voids the original legal relationship, and in adoption cases the court records are sealed and new birth certificates may be issued.
birth certificate.zh: 它使原法律关系归于**无效**(void)，**收养**(adoption)案件中法院卷宗密封，可签发新的**出生证明**(birth certificate)。

clerk.s: Typically, they begin the process by paying a fee and obtaining a license from a public official, often the county clerk.
clerk.zh: 通常先缴费，向公职人员（多为**县书记官**(county clerk)）申领**结婚许可证**(marriage license)。

majority opinion.s: In his majority opinion, Justice William O. Douglas wrote, "But that doctrine has no place in the modern world.
majority opinion.zh: 威廉·O·道格拉斯大法官在多数意见中写道："但该原则在现代世界已无立足之地。

due process clause.s: The Court ruled 9 to 0 that the Due Process Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment requires states to provide free counsel to indigent defendants in all noncapital felony cases.
due process clause.zh: 法院以9比0裁定，**第十四修正案**(fourteenth amendment)**正当程序条款**(due process clause)要求各州在一切非死刑重罪案件中为贫困被告提供免费律师。

unconstitutional.s: He challenged the conviction on the ground that the statute was unconstitutional because Congress had exceeded its authority under the Commerce Clause in enacting the law.
unconstitutional.zh: 他以**制定法**(statute)**违宪**(unconstitutional)挑战定罪，理由是国会立法超越**商业条款**(commerce clause)授权。

pension.s: As traditional views of the role of women have changed, laws dealing with the rights of women in employment, pension plans, credit, and child support have changed to keep pace.
pension.zh: 随着对妇女角色传统看法的改变，涉及妇女在就业、养老金计划、信贷和子女抚养费方面权利的法律也随之改变以跟上步伐。

social security.s: For example, in administrative law, the Social Security Administration has regulations (laws) that determine who is eligible for Social Security benefits.
social security.zh: 例如，在**行政法**(administrative law)中，社会保障署有决定谁有资格领取社会保障金的规章（法律），另有规章规定申请福利必须遵循的程序。

community property.s: In both the community property and common law states, the same factors are typically considered in the property settlement.
community property.zh: **夫妻共同财产**(community property)州与**普通法**(common law)州在**财产和解**(property settlement)中考虑的因素大体相同，包括年龄、健康、职业、其他**资产**(asset)与双方收入能力。

rules of evidence.s: Federal courts have their own unique rules of evidence, but evidence is submitted and a verdict is reached in the same manner as in state trial courts.
rules of evidence.zh: 联邦法院有自己独特的**证据规则**(rules of evidence)，但**证据**(evidence)的提交与**裁断**(verdict)的作出方式与州初审法院相同。

marital privilege.s: The inception date also affects many other matters such as the marital privilege in the rules of evidence.
marital privilege.zh: 起始日期还影响**证据规则**(rules of evidence)中的**配偶特权**(marital privilege)等诸多事项。

domicile.s: The primary right is to have physical possession of the child and to establish his or her legal domicile without interference by third parties.
domicile.zh: 首要权利是**实际占有**(physical possession)子女、确定其法律上的**住所**(domicile)，不受第三人干涉。

employer.s: In this manner, employers were permitted to keep wages low, hours long, working conditions unsafe, and workers insecure.
employer.zh: 法官常常同情**雇主**(employer)，把**财产权**(property right)置于**工人**(worker)获得**体面工资**(decent wage)与**工作条件**(working conditions)的权利之上。

county clerk.s: Typically, they begin the process by paying a fee and obtaining a license from a public official, often the county clerk.
county clerk.zh: 通常先缴费，向公职人员（多为**县书记官**(county clerk)）申领**结婚许可证**(marriage license)。

formal marriage.s: All states have standards for formal marriages, while only a few make provisions for informal marriages, but the validity of a marriage is determined by the local law.
formal marriage.zh: 各州都有**正式婚姻**(formal marriage)的标准，只有少数州规定了**非正式婚姻**(informal marriage)，**婚姻**(marriage)效力依**地方性法律**(local law)判定。

bigamy.s: A spouse who enters into an informal marriage and later formally marries without first obtaining a divorce may be subject to bigamy charges.
bigamy.zh: 已缔结**非正式婚姻**(informal marriage)而未先**离婚**(divorce)又**正式**(formal)结婚的一方，可能被控**重婚**(bigamy)。

ceremonial marriage.s: The vast majority of couples are joined through ceremonial marriages.
ceremonial marriage.zh: 绝大多数夫妻通过**仪式婚姻**(ceremonial marriage)结合。

spousal support.s: The court may consider these factors in dividing the property and in setting spousal support if permitted by state law.
spousal support.zh: 法院分割**财产**(property)、确定**配偶扶养费**(spousal support)（如**州法**(state law)允许）时可考虑这些因素。

plea bargain.s: Because confessions are seldom the only evidence the police have, criminal defendants prefer to plea bargain rather than take chances at trial.
plea bargain.zh: 警察仍能取得口供的主要原因是**控辩交易**(plea bargaining)——有罪者仍愿以供认换取降格指控或轻刑。

annulment.s: Divorces are much more common than annulments because of the extremely limited grounds for annulments.
annulment.zh: 例如詹妮弗与彼得结婚时都未成年，若视为**可撤销**(voidable)**婚姻**(marriage)，双方既可以此为由申请**无效宣告**(annulment)，也可当作已满足前提继续**婚姻**(marriage)。

trier of fact.s: For example, the party who alleges adultery must introduce evidence and persuade the trier of fact that such activity did occur.
trier of fact.zh: 例如，主张**通奸**(adultery)的一方须**举证**(burden of proof)并说服**事实裁判者**(trier of fact)确有其事，程序常常昂贵（且难堪）。

residency.s: A typical requirement is that one or both parties meet residency requirements.
residency.zh: 内华达以六周的超短**居住期**(residency period)闻名；51 阿拉斯加只要求一方为本州居民；52 得克萨斯要求起诉前在本州有六个月**住所**(domicile)、在本县住满90天。

support.s: The courts are there only to resolve the legal issues of dissolution, property, custody, and support in accordance with the statutes and legal precepts.
support.zh: 法院只按**制定法**(statute)与**法律准则**(legal precept)解决**解除**(dissolution)、**财产**(property)、**监护权**(custody)与**扶养**(support)的法律问题。

child support.s: Some divorce-related issues may drag on for many years; failure to pay spousal support or child support in accordance with the court order are common examples.
child support.zh: 有些**离婚**(divorce)相关问题可拖延多年，不按**法院命令**(court order)支付**配偶扶养费**(spousal support)或**子女扶养费**(child support)就是常见例子。

venue.s: District courts may have the prerequisites of jurisdiction to hear felony cases, but the venue statute will limit the venue to the county in which the crime occurred.
venue.zh: 地区法院可能具备审理**重罪**(felony)案件的管辖（jurisdiction）要件，但**审判地制定法**(venue statute)将**审判地**(venue)限定在犯罪发生的县。

divorce petition.s: One reason to allege fault in a divorce petition or to prove fault at trial is to affect child custody or the property division against the wrongdoer.
divorce petition.zh: 在**离婚诉状**(divorce petition)中主张**过错**(fault)或在**审判**(trial)中**证明**(proof)**过错**(fault)，目的之一是让子女**监护权**(custody)或**财产分割**(property division)对**过错方**(at-fault party)不利。

separation.s: Once the line is crossed, delegation is termed "excessive," in violation of the constitutional doctrine of separation of powers.
separation.zh: 一旦越过界限，授权即被称为“过度”授权，违反宪法分权原则。

burden of proof.s: If, for example, the plaintiff has failed to carry the burden of proof in the case, the judge may well grant the defense lawyer’s motion for a directed verdict.
burden of proof.zh: 例如**原告**(plaintiff)未完成**证明责任**(burden of proof)，法官很可能准辩方律师的**指示裁决**(directed verdict)动议；反之**被告**(defendant)未能有效反驳**原告**(plaintiff)的指控与**证据**(evidence)，法官可准**原告**(plaintiff)动议。

desertion.s: Typical grounds of fault are adultery, desertion, and cruelty.
desertion.zh: 典型**过错**(fault)**理由**(ground)是**通奸**(adultery)、**遗弃**(desertion)与**虐待**(cruelty)。

cruelty.s: Typical grounds of fault are adultery, desertion, and cruelty.
cruelty.zh: 典型**过错**(fault)**理由**(ground)是**通奸**(adultery)、**遗弃**(desertion)与**虐待**(cruelty)。

trial.s: One reason to allege fault in a divorce petition or to prove fault at trial is to affect child custody or the property division against the wrongdoer.
trial.zh: 在**离婚诉状**(divorce petition)中主张**过错**(fault)或在**审判**(trial)中**证明**(proof)**过错**(fault)，目的之一是让子女**监护权**(custody)或**财产分割**(property division)对**过错方**(at-fault party)不利。

contested case.s: In contested cases, the allegations will generally be brought out in testimony and may be considered by the judge in allocating the marital resources.
contested case.zh: 在**有争议案件**(contested case)中，这些指控一般会在**作证**(testimony)时抛出，法官分配**婚姻财产**(marital property)时可予考虑。

testimony.s: In contested cases, the allegations will generally be brought out in testimony and may be considered by the judge in allocating the marital resources.
testimony.zh: 在有争议的案件中，主张通常会在庭审证言中提出，法官在分配婚姻财产时可予考虑。

marital property.s: He has an annual income of $200,000, while she has no income and no assets other than the marital property.
marital property.zh: 他年收入20万美元，她除**婚姻财产**(marital property)外没有收入和**资产**(asset)。

negotiation.s: In uncontested cases, they may be used in negotiations as a bargaining chip.
negotiation.zh: 在**无争议案件**(uncontested case)中，可用作**谈判**(negotiation)**筹码**(bargaining chip)。

collaborative divorce.s: A number of couples are opting to pursue collaborative divorces in lieu of extensive (and expensive) litigation.
collaborative divorce.zh: 56 已故演员罗宾·威廉姆斯与其前妻玛莎·加西斯·威廉姆斯在**合作式离婚**(collaborative divorce)**协议**(agreement)中写道：“我们将诚实、合作、互相尊重地走完这一程序，为家庭未来的福祉而努力。

collaborative law.s: Patrick Foran, "Adoption of the Uniform Collaborative Law Act in Oregon: The Right Time and the Right Reasons," 13 Lewis & Clark L. Rev.
collaborative law.zh: 56. 中文：帕特里克·福兰，《俄勒冈通过〈**统一合作式法律法**(uniform collaborative law act)〉：恰当的时机与恰当的理由》，《刘易斯与克拉克法律评论》第13卷（2009年）第787页。

adr.s: One trend in ADR is court-annexed arbitration.
adr.zh: 替代性纠纷解决的一大趋势是法院附设仲裁。

settlement.s: A court must have jurisdiction to grant a divorce, to enter a property settlement, and to decide custody of the couple's children.
settlement.zh: 法院须有管辖权才能准予离婚、作出财产分割，并裁决子女监护权。

support order.s: Division of property orders typically cannot be enforced by civil contempt, but spousal support orders can be.
support order.zh: 财产分割令通常不得以民事藐视法庭强制执行，但配偶扶养令可以。

hearing.s: At the time of the divorce hearing, the property and the debts are divided between the spouses.
hearing.zh: 在离婚听证时，财产和债务在配偶之间分割。

asset.s: He has an annual income of $200,000, while she has no income and no assets other than the marital property.
asset.zh: 他年收入20万美元，她除**婚姻财产**(marital property)外没有收入和**资产**(asset)。

equitable remedy.s: In addition to damages, the plaintiff in a nuisance suit may also be awarded the equitable remedy of injunction.
equitable remedy.zh: 除损害赔偿外，妨害诉讼的原告还可获得禁令这一衡平救济。

wages.s: Judges, often sympathetic to the views of the owners, placed property rights above the workers' rights to decent wages and working conditions.
wages.zh: 法官常常同情**雇主**(employer)，把**财产权**(property right)置于**工人**(worker)获得**体面工资**(decent wage)与**工作条件**(working conditions)的权利之上。

property settlement.s: A court must have jurisdiction to grant a divorce, to enter a property settlement, and to decide custody of the couple's children.
property settlement.zh: 法院须有**司法管辖权**(jurisdiction)才能准予**离婚**(divorce)、作出**财产分割**(property division)并裁定子女**监护权**(custody)。

no-fault divorce.s: The recognition of a homemaker's financial contributions to the marriage, along with no-fault divorce, was an integral part of divorce reform in the last decades.
no-fault divorce.zh: 承认主妇对**婚姻**(marriage)的经济贡献，连同**无过错离婚**(no-fault divorce)，是近几十年**离婚**(divorce)改革的核心内容。

installment payment.s: In some instances, installment payments of the property settlement are permitted, but these must be distinguished from spousal support.
installment payment.zh: 有时允许**分期付款**(installment payment)支付**财产和解款**(property settlement payment)，但须与**配偶扶养费**(spousal support)区分。

taxation.s: The third court, the Exchequer, dealt primarily with matters of revenue and taxation.
taxation.zh: 第三个法院即财政法院，主要管税收事项。

bankruptcy law.s: The two are treated differently under federal tax and bankruptcy laws.
bankruptcy law.zh: **联邦税法**(federal tax law)与**破产法**(bankruptcy law)对两者区别对待。

civil contempt.s: Division of property orders typically cannot be enforced by civil contempt, but spousal support orders can be.
civil contempt.zh: **财产分割命令**(property division order)一般不能以**民事藐视法庭**(civil contempt)执行，**配偶扶养费**(spousal support)命令则可以。

best interest of the child.s: As previously discussed, the best interest of the child is a nebulous standard that allows judges to exercise a great deal of discretion.
best interest of the child.zh: 法院**批准**(approval)**收养**(adoption)申请的标准，是**收养**(adoption)是否符合**子女最佳利益**(best interest of the child)。

best interest.s: The criterion used by the court to judge whether to grant an adoption petition is whether the adoption will be in the child's best interest.
best interest.zh: 法院**批准**(approval)**收养**(adoption)申请的标准，是**收养**(adoption)是否符合**子女最佳利益**(best interest of the child)。

guardianship.s: To iterate, each state has a different statutory scheme regarding intestacy and the guardianship of minor children.
guardianship.zh: 重申，各州**无遗嘱继承**(intestacy)与未成年子女监护方案各异。

physical possession.s: The primary right is to have physical possession of the child and to establish his or her legal domicile without interference by third parties.
physical possession.zh: 若涉嫌或证实**虐待**(cruelty)儿童，或**法院命令**(court order)的其他情形，国家可介入取得**实际占有**(physical possession)。

visitation rights.s: Visitation rights may be withheld or circumscribed at the court's discretion.
visitation rights.zh: **监护权**(custody)与**探视权**(visitation rights)可按子女需求量身定制，颇具创意，例如**判决**(judgment)让孩子留住家中、父母轮流进出。

visitation.s: Visitation rights may be withheld or circumscribed at the court's discretion.
visitation.zh: 有**虐待**(cruelty)行为或曾抢夺子女的父母，可能只被允许在祖父母家或州社会服务机构办公室**探视**(visitation)。

custodial parent.s: To the custodial parent, the state's child support laws may seem like the protector of the child's rights.
custodial parent.zh: 对**享有监护权的一方**(custodial parent)而言，州的**子女扶养费**(child support)法像是子女权利的**保护者**(protector)。

contempt of court.s: The losing defendant may be imprisoned (e.g., for contempt of court), required to pay either compensatory or punitive damages, or mandated to transfer property to the plaintiff.
contempt of court.zh: 败诉**被告**(defendant)可被监禁（如因**藐视法庭**(contempt of court)）、判付补偿性或惩罚性**损害赔偿**(damages)，或被令向**原告**(plaintiff)移交财产。

delinquency.s: For example, juvenile laws are often contained in family codes, and cases involving alleged delinquency are routinely decided by family law judges.
delinquency.zh: 例如，少年法常载于家庭法典，被控违法的案件通常由家事法官裁决。

self-help.s: Again, this is not the ideal time to employ self-help methods or to ignore probate if one wishes to have legal title to any property one inherits.
self-help.zh: 同样，若想合法取得继承财产的所有权，此时不宜自力救济，也不应无视遗嘱认证程序。

fine.s: These laws essentially set the fines for injury to the person or damage to the property of another.
fine.zh: 这些法律基本上规定侵害他人人身或损坏他人财产的**罚金**(fine)：割掉耳朵罚12先令，刺穿耳朵罚3先令，失聪罚25先令。

imprisonment.s: For example, in Duncan v. Louisiana, the Court ruled that due process requires a jury trial where the maximum punishment possible is two years’ imprisonment.
imprisonment.zh: 例如，在邓肯诉路易斯安那州案（Duncan v. Louisiana）中，法院裁定最高可判两年监禁时**正当程序**(due process)要求陪审团审判。

filing.s: Prior to actually filing a suit, the plaintiff will usually consult a lawyer, who will advise him about the soundness of his case.
filing.zh: 在实际起诉前，原告通常会咨询律师，请律师评估案件的胜算。

opportunity to be heard.s: Remember that the defendant, whether a natural person or a corporation, must receive adequate notice of the proceedings and an opportunity to be heard.
opportunity to be heard.zh: 须记住，被告无论是自然人还是**法人**(corporation)，都必须获得程序的充分通知和陈述机会。

absent parent.s: The state agencies have access to the parent-locator service and to the national new hire registry to locate absent parents.
absent parent.zh: 计划主要针对领取**政府救济**(government assistance)子女的**缺席父母**(absent parent)，也帮助所有人确立与执行**扶养义务**(support obligation)。

probation.s: The national government not only has a separate set of laws and courts but it also has a separate program for corrections, including probation and prisons.
probation.zh: 联邦政府不仅有独立的法律法院体系，也有独立的矫正体系，包括**缓刑**(probation)与监狱。

family code.s: For example, juvenile laws are often contained in family codes, and cases involving alleged delinquency are routinely decided by family law judges.
family code.zh: 例如少年法常载于**家庭法典**(family code)，被指不良行为的案件通常由**家事法官**(family law judge)裁判。

uniform collaborative law act.s: Patrick Foran, "Adoption of the Uniform Collaborative Law Act in Oregon: The Right Time and the Right Reasons," 13 Lewis & Clark L. Rev.
uniform collaborative law act.zh: 56. 中文：帕特里克·福兰，《俄勒冈通过〈**统一合作式法律法**(uniform collaborative law act)〉：恰当的时机与恰当的理由》，《刘易斯与克拉克法律评论》第13卷（2009年）第787页。

legitimate.s: Legitimate children are allowed by the law to claim support from both parents as well as to inherit from them.
legitimate.zh: 78 传统上，已婚妇女经**人工授精**(artificial insemination)受孕所生子女视为丈夫的**婚生子女**(legitimate child)；一些州要求手术前须有丈夫的书面事先同意。

guardian.s: The Supreme Court, in a sense, acts as both the conscience of the nation and the guardian of its constitutional values.
guardian.zh: 最高法院在某种意义上既是国家的良心，也是其宪法价值的守护者。

natural father.s: For many years, bastards (in the legal sense only) could not claim support or inherit from their natural fathers.
natural father.zh: 多年里，私生子（仅法律意义上）不能向**生父**(natural father)主张**扶养**(support)，也不能**继承**(inheritance)。

artificial insemination.s: We have seen the emergence of a third method: by contract, in situations of artificial insemination or with surrogate mothers.
artificial insemination.zh: 第三条路已经出现：**人工授精**(artificial insemination)或**代孕母亲**(surrogate mother)情形下的**合同**(contract)确立。

paternity.s: In addition, there are paternity statutes––the bases for judicial determination as to the existence of the relationship.
paternity.zh: 此外还有亲子关系法，即司法确定亲子关系是否存在的依据。

parental rights.s: Parents may accede to the termination of parental rights or it may be involuntary.
parental rights.zh: **亲权终止**(termination of parental rights)可以是父母同意的，也可以是非自愿的。

termination of parental rights.s: Parents may accede to the termination of parental rights or it may be involuntary.
termination of parental rights.zh: **亲权终止**(termination of parental rights)可以是父母同意的，也可以是非自愿的。

surrogate mother.s: We have seen the emergence of a third method: by contract, in situations of artificial insemination or with surrogate mothers.
surrogate mother.zh: 第三条路已经出现：**人工授精**(artificial insemination)或**代孕母亲**(surrogate mother)情形下的**合同**(contract)确立。

perception.s: In a sense, then, our perceptions about the nature and meaning of law have colored the contents of this book.
perception.zh: 从这个意义上说，我们对法律性质与含义的**认知**(perception)，给本书的内容染上了色彩。

protector.s: That is, the law serves as the protector of property rights.
protector.zh: 再举一例，可帮助阐明法律兼为**保护者**(protector)与**压迫者**(oppressor)的观点。

oppressor.s: Government is indeed capable of being both protector and oppressor, as history certainly confirms.
oppressor.zh: 历史充分**证实**(confirm)，政府确实既能充当**保护者**(protector)，也能充当**压迫者**(oppressor)。

noncustodial spouse.s: On the other hand, the noncustodial spouse may see the state's child support laws as a burden, particularly if there is any controversy about how the funds are spent.
noncustodial spouse.zh: 而对**不享有监护权的一方**(noncustodial spouse)来说，州的**子女扶养费**(child support)法却是一种负担，尤其当款项用途存在争议时更是如此。

legal profession.s: The dominance of the legal profession in our political institutions is not the only way that law and politics interact.
legal profession.zh: **法律职业**(legal profession)在政治制度中的主导地位，只是法律与政治互动的方式之一。

member of congress.s: At any given time, approximately half the members of Congress are lawyers.
member of congress.zh: 任何时候，**国会议员**(member of congress)中约有一半是律师。

judicial branch.s: Both the “gatekeeping” aspects and the legalistic rules affect access to the courts and the availability of relief for those seeking assistance from the judicial branch.
judicial branch.zh: “守门”方面和法律技术性规则，都影响接近法院的机会和向司法分支求助者获得**救济**(remedy)的可能性。

senate judiciary committee.s: The researchers classified questions of the Senate Judiciary Committee members as “character,” “competence,” or “constitutional philosophy” questions.
senate judiciary committee.zh: 近年来人们日益关注参议院司法委员会在选任中的角色，尤其在最高法院层面。

capital punishment.s: As noted in Chapter 6, the issues of same-sex marriage, abortion, gun control, and capital punishment are perennial issues before the courts of the nation.
capital punishment.zh: 正如第六章所述，**同性婚姻**(same-sex marriage)、**堕胎**(abortion)、**枪支管制**(gun control)与**死刑**(capital punishment)是全国法院经久不衰的议题。

offense.s: Until the 1963 Gideon v. Wainwright3 decision, indigent persons accused of noncapital offenses were forced in most states either to defend themselves at trial or to plead guilty.
offense.zh: 直到一九六三年吉迪恩诉温赖特案判决前，在多数州，被控非死罪的贫困被告人要么自行辩护，要么认罪。

tobacco industry.s: For most of our nation's history, the tobacco industry has been relatively immune from legal process and political opposition.
tobacco industry.zh: 在几位进取心强的**州检察长**(state attorney general)的带领下，社会开始要求**烟草业**(tobacco industry)为其产品的健康后果承担更大的责任。

legal process.s: For most of our nation's history, the tobacco industry has been relatively immune from legal process and political opposition.
legal process.zh: 在我国历史的大部分时间里，**烟草业**(tobacco industry)相对不受**法律程序**(legal process)与政治反对的影响。

smoker.s: The industry was also successful in defending itself against lawsuits from injured smokers.
smoker.zh: 多数人把吸烟看作个人选择，**吸烟者**(smoker)应自行承担吸烟决定的后果（数十年前开始吸烟的人常常并不知晓这些后果）。

indigent.s: Until the 1963 Gideon v. Wainwright3 decision, indigent persons accused of noncapital offenses were forced in most states either to defend themselves at trial or to plead guilty.
indigent.zh: 在1963年**吉迪恩诉温赖特案**(gideon v. wainwright)3**判决**(decision)之前，多数州被控非**死罪**(capital offense)的**贫困**(indigent)者要么在**审判**(trial)中自行辩护，要么**认罪**(plead guilty)。

victim.s: States, realizing the public health costs of treating indigent and elderly victims of smoking-related diseases, have successfully sued tobacco companies.
victim.zh: 各州意识到救治吸烟相关疾病中的**贫困**(indigent)与老年**受害者**(victim)的**公共卫生**(public health)成本，转而成功起诉了烟草公司。

criminal justice.s: Pretrial Procedures The process of criminal justice begins with the arrest of the defendant.
criminal justice.zh: 刑事司法始于逮捕**被告**(defendant)：被害人、证人或警官（称**控告证人**(complaining witness)）宣誓提出**刑事控告书**(complaint)，**治安法官**(magistrate)据此签发**逮捕证**(arrest warrant)。

crime.s: Crimes that once resulted in hanging, such as horse stealing and bank robbery, are treated today like any other theft of property.
crime.zh: 偷马、抢银行等当年会被绞死的**犯罪**(crime)，今天与一般财产**盗窃**(theft)无异。

safeguard.s: Whether they "overreacted" by placing so many safeguards into the Constitution is also open to discussion.
safeguard.zh: 他们是否因在**宪法**(constitution)中设置过多**保障**(safeguard)而“反应过度”，同样可以讨论。

consensus.s: Perhaps someday we will reach a similar consensus on the decriminalization of a range of other activities, including gambling and marijuana use.
consensus.zh: 也许有朝一日，我们会对一系列其他行为的**非刑事化**(decriminalization)达成类似**共识**(consensus)，包括**赌博**(gambling)与**大麻**(marijuana)使用。

justice.s: Our ideas and ideals about decency, justice, and due process evolve over time.
justice.zh: 我们关于**体面**(decency)、**正义**(justice)与**正当程序**(due process)的观念和理想随时间演进。

penalty.s: Contrary to what many think, the Supreme Court has never held the death penalty to be unconstitutional.
penalty.zh: 与许多人的想法相反，最高法院从未裁定死刑违宪。

decriminalization.s: Perhaps someday we will reach a similar consensus on the decriminalization of a range of other activities, including gambling and marijuana use.
decriminalization.zh: 也许有朝一日，我们会对一系列其他行为的**非刑事化**(decriminalization)达成类似**共识**(consensus)，包括**赌博**(gambling)与**大麻**(marijuana)使用。

gambling.s: Any or all of these could be reasons that a legislature might choose to prohibit gambling.
gambling.zh: 然而，拉斯维加斯这类地方的成功以及许多州赌场**赌博**(gambling)合法化表明，数百万人认为它并无危害。

marijuana.s: Indeed some states, like Colorado, have legalized the sale and possession of marijuana, while others still categorize both as crimes.
marijuana.zh: 许多人虽然仍认为应当禁止吸食大麻，但认为相比制造或贩卖毒品，仅持有毒品之罪的**刑罚**(penalty)过重。

labor union.s: During the early struggle between labor unions and management, the latter would use court injunctions as a weapon against striking workers.
labor union.zh: 在**工会**(labor union)与**资方**(management)的早期斗争中，**资方**(management)把法院**禁令**(injunction)当作对付**罢工**(strike)**工人**(worker)的武器。

management.s: During the early struggle between labor unions and management, the latter would use court injunctions as a weapon against striking workers.
management.zh: 在**工会**(labor union)与**资方**(management)的早期斗争中，**资方**(management)把法院**禁令**(injunction)当作对付**罢工**(strike)**工人**(worker)的武器。

strike.s: The use of the injunction as a strike-breaker also illustrates the importance placed on property rights in our legal system.
strike.zh: 在**工会**(labor union)与**资方**(management)的早期斗争中，**资方**(management)把法院**禁令**(injunction)当作对付**罢工**(strike)**工人**(worker)的武器。

worker.s: Judges, often sympathetic to the views of the owners, placed property rights above the workers' rights to decent wages and working conditions.
worker.zh: 在**工会**(labor union)与**资方**(management)的早期斗争中，**资方**(management)把法院**禁令**(injunction)当作对付**罢工**(strike)**工人**(worker)的武器。

working conditions.s: Judges, often sympathetic to the views of the owners, placed property rights above the workers' rights to decent wages and working conditions.
working conditions.zh: 法官常常同情**雇主**(employer)，把**财产权**(property right)置于**工人**(worker)获得**体面工资**(decent wage)与**工作条件**(working conditions)的权利之上。

economic impact.s: We are, however, prepared to say that the economic impact of the law is a powerful influence on the way in which law in our society is shaped.
economic impact.zh: 但我们敢说，法律的**经济影响**(economic impact)，是塑造我们社会法律形态的强大力量。

gideon v. wainwright.s: In Chapter 6, we chronicled how the Supreme Court extended the privilege in Powell v. Alabama, Gideon v. Wainwright, and Argersinger v. Hamlin.
gideon v. wainwright.zh: 在第6章中，我们叙述了最高法院如何在鲍威尔诉亚拉巴马州案、吉迪恩诉温赖特案和阿格辛格诉哈姆林案中扩展该特权。

decision.s: The decisions of a court of appeals may never be reviewed or overturned by the Supreme Court, so the precedents set by them are the law within that circuit.
decision.zh: 只有极小部分联邦案件能到最高法院，上诉法院判决常为终局，可能永不被最高法院审查或推翻，其确立的先例即巡回区内的法律。

capital offense.s: In Texas, the murder of a police officer is a capital offense, but the prosecutor must prove that the defendant knew that his or her victim was a police officer.
capital offense.zh: 在得克萨斯州，谋杀警察属于**死罪**(capital offense)（可判死刑之罪），但检察官必须证明被告人知道被害人是警察。

plead guilty.s: Until the 1963 Gideon v. Wainwright3 decision, indigent persons accused of noncapital offenses were forced in most states either to defend themselves at trial or to plead guilty.
plead guilty.zh: 在1963年**吉迪恩诉温赖特案**(gideon v. wainwright)3**判决**(decision)之前，多数州被控非**死罪**(capital offense)的**贫困**(indigent)者要么在**审判**(trial)中自行辩护，要么**认罪**(plead guilty)。

indigent defendant.s: Until the Gideon decision ruled that states must provide counsel for indigent defendants, those who were economically disadvantaged were also legally disadvantaged.
indigent defendant.zh: 直到吉迪恩案**判决**(decision)要求各州必须为**贫困被告人**(indigent defendant)提供律师，经济上的弱势才不再意味着法律上的弱势。

physician.s: Physicians and insurance companies have been opposed in their efforts to win tort reform by segments of the legal profession.
physician.zh: 双方都不乏有力论据，但我们的观点是，**医生**(physician)、律师、**原告**(plaintiff)与**保险公司**(insurance company)都在利用法律增进各自的**经济私利**(economic self-interest)。

tort reform.s: Physicians and insurance companies have been opposed in their efforts to win tort reform by segments of the legal profession.
tort reform.zh: **医生**(physician)与**保险公司**(insurance company)争取**侵权法改革**(tort reform)的努力，遭到了**法律职业**(legal profession)中部分人士的反对。

insurance company.s: This may require the defendant to sell his property or to borrow the needed money, but it usually means the defendant’s insurance company will pay.
insurance company.zh: 以我们为例的**过失**(negligence)案，**被告**(defendant)须赔庭审判定的**损害赔偿**(damages)，可能要卖产借钱，通常由其保险公司赔付。

contingency fee.s: Physicians argue that lawyers may not be totally neutral parties because they are often working on a contingency fee basis.
contingency fee.zh: **医生**(physician)认为律师未必完全中立，因为他们常常按**风险代理收费**(contingency fee)工作。

large award.s: Lawyers counter that large awards are given only in cases of extreme or gross negligence, that they are usually justified, and that the jury system serves as a check on any abuses.
large award.zh: 律师反驳说，**高额赔偿**(large award)只出现在极端或**重大过失**(gross negligence)案件中，通常是正当的，**陪审团制度**(jury system)足以制约**滥用**(abuse)。

gross negligence.s: Lawyers counter that large awards are given only in cases of extreme or gross negligence, that they are usually justified, and that the jury system serves as a check on any abuses.
gross negligence.zh: 律师反驳说，**高额赔偿**(large award)只出现在极端或**重大过失**(gross negligence)案件中，通常是正当的，**陪审团制度**(jury system)足以制约**滥用**(abuse)。

jury system.s: Lawyers counter that large awards are given only in cases of extreme or gross negligence, that they are usually justified, and that the jury system serves as a check on any abuses.
jury system.zh: 律师反驳说，**高额赔偿**(large award)只出现在极端或**重大过失**(gross negligence)案件中，通常是正当的，**陪审团制度**(jury system)足以制约**滥用**(abuse)。

conviction.s: One usually hears the relative of a murder victim express satisfaction that "justice was finally done" upon learning of the killer's conviction.
conviction.zh: 谋杀案**受害者**(victim)家属得知凶手被**定罪**(conviction)后说“**正义**(justice)终于得到伸张”，人们对此习以为常。

retribution.s: There are three primary models of punishment: retribution, deterrence, and rehabilitation.
retribution.zh: **刑罚**(punishment)有三种主要模式：**报应**(retribution)、**威慑**(deterrence)与**改造**(rehabilitation)。

civil case.s: For example, the Texas Supreme Court hears only civil cases, while criminal cases are handled by the Texas Court of Criminal Appeals.
civil case.zh: 大多数州只有一家终审法院，民刑上诉兼理，但俄克拉荷马和得克萨斯有两家：如得州最高法院只审民事案件，刑事案件由得州**刑事上诉法院**(court of criminal appeals)管辖。

civil suit.s: At that point, the EPA could file a civil suit, but as the EPA had no power to enforce the law, the case had to be turned over to the Department of Justice for prosecution.
civil suit.zh: 守法令载明违法事项并给予合理改正期限；若仍未改正，**环境保护署**(epa)无权直接处罚，只能提起**民事诉讼**(civil suit)，且因其无执法权，案件须移交司法部起诉。

principle.s: Given the expense in time and money and the uncertainty of success, principle probably does play a major role in most lawsuits.
principle.zh: 虽然不能完全排除**贪婪**(avarice)是动机，但**民事诉讼**(civil suit)的**诉讼当事人**(litigant)常常否认自己为钱而诉，声称所争的是“其中的**原则**(principle)”。

hero.s: People want a hero who will protect them from the injustices of life and the wrath of their enemies.
hero.zh: 对许多人而言，法律就是这样的**英雄**(hero)——一位随时准备施以援手的伟大**平等者**(equalizer)。

code of hammurabi.s: One of the earliest extant sets of laws is the Code of Hammurabi, developed by King Hammurabi of Babylon about 2000 bce.
code of hammurabi.zh: 近300条的汉谟拉比法典涵盖司法行政、财产、灌溉、借贷利息、贸易管制、奴隶制、婚姻家庭、收养、**人身伤害**(personal injury)、建筑和工资管制等诸多方面。

personal injury.s: In a personal injury case, the plaintiff may have to produce copies of a medical exam report and of hospital and doctors’ bills to establish the extent of the injury.
personal injury.zh: 例如讨债案中**被告**(defendant)可能被要求出示收据或兑现支票以证明已还债；人身伤害案中**原告**(plaintiff)可能须出示体检报告及医院、医生账单复制件以证明伤情。

witness.s: Fourth, the witnesses present at the time of transaction were identified in the document.
witness.zh: 除发达的**刑法**(criminal law)体系外，古美索不达米亚人还形成了沿用至今的严格**合同**(contract)起草范式：第一，标明交易标的（如婚姻**合同**(contract)或**不动产**(real property)**租赁**(lease)）；第二，列明交易各方，清楚标明相互关系中的角色，如卖方与买方；第三，加上价格、承担义务等细节条款；第四，在文书中载明交易时在场的**证人**(witness)。

death penalty.s: Contrary to what many think, the Supreme Court has never held the death penalty to be unconstitutional.
death penalty.zh: 法院裁定的是判处**死刑**(death penalty)的程序违宪，因其允许**陪审团**(jury)在量刑时“专横反复”[113]，但精心起草、给予量刑者充分信息指引的制定法可补救该缺陷。

twelve tables.s: The Twelve Tables, written around 450 bce, are often cited as the beginning of the Roman law.
twelve tables.zh: 约公元前450年写成的**十二表法**(twelve tables)常被引为罗马法的开端。

corpus juris civilis.s: In 528 ce, the emperor Justinian collected the laws of the vast empire and published them as the Code of Justinian, or Corpus Juris Civilis.
corpus juris civilis.zh: 公元528年，查士丁尼皇帝汇集庞大帝国的法律，颁布为《查士丁尼法典》即**国法大全**(corpus juris civilis)。

private law.s: The two were not contradictory in the area of private law.
private law.zh: 两者在**私法**(private law)领域并不矛盾。

codification.s: Second, the Natural Law school spurred extensive codifications that led to the fusion of theoretical and practical law.
codification.zh: 第二，**自然法**(natural law)学派推动了大规模**法典化**(codification)，促成理论法与实践法融合。

inquisitorial process.s: These systems employ an inquisitorial process of trial.
inquisitorial process.zh: 这些制度采用**纠问制**(inquisitorial process)审判。

napoleonic code.s: The "most potent" civil law source is the Napoleonic Code that is modified to meet the unique requirements of Islam.
napoleonic code.zh: 最有力的**大陆法系**(civil law)渊源是按伊斯兰独特要求改造的《拿破仑法典》。

islamic law.s: Modern Islamic nations often seek to synthesize Islamic laws with other systems, especially the Roman-Germanic traditions.
islamic law.zh: **伊斯兰法**(islamic law)在美国最明显的影响之一，是在押黑人穆斯林援引第一修正案**宗教活动自由条款**(free exercise clause)寻求保护的囚犯权利案件。

adversarial.s: Stephen Landsman, Readings in Adversarial Justice: The American Approach to Adjudication (St. Paul, MN: West, 1988), pp.
adversarial.zh: 斯蒂芬·兰兹曼，《对抗制司法读本：美国裁判进路》（圣保罗：威斯特出版社，1988年），第38–39页。

inquisitorial.s: These systems employ an inquisitorial process of trial.
inquisitorial.zh: 这些制度采用**纠问制**(inquisitorial process)审判。

exclusionary rule.s: The exclusionary rule states that evidence obtained in violation of a person's constitutional rights must be excluded from the trial of the accused person.
exclusionary rule.zh: **证据排除规则**(exclusionary rule)虽在**搜查与扣押**(search and seizure)背景下发展，后扩展至被告人其他宪法权利被侵犯的情形。

customary law.s: Improving Water Governance in Yunnan China Through Environmental Customary Law," 15 Vt.
customary law.zh: 经由环境**习惯法**(customary law)改善中国云南水治理》，《佛蒙特环境法杂志》15卷291页（2014年），第305页。

separation of powers.s: Once the line is crossed, delegation is termed "excessive," in violation of the constitutional doctrine of separation of powers.
separation of powers.zh: 现代宪法以“宪法只禁‘过度授权’”之说绕过不授权神话：最高法院裁定适度**授权**(delegation)合宪可取，但向行政机关**授权**(delegation)有不可逾越之线，越线即“过度”**授权**(delegation)，违反宪法**分权**(separation of powers)学说。

grand jury.s: Indictment by information is preferred by those who seek greater efficiency in criminal justice because it is less troublesome than the grand jury system.
grand jury.zh: 求刑事司法效率者取其简便，嫌**大陪审团**(grand jury)麻烦；虽可能被过火**检察官**(prosecutor)滥用，采用州似乎满意。

oath.s: At that time, the defendant would be placed under oath and questioned by the chancellor, who determined questions of both law and fact and then shaped a remedy.
oath.zh: **被告**(defendant)须**宣誓**(oath)接受**大法官**(chancellor)讯问，由其裁断法律事实问题，再量身**救济**(remedy)。

compurgation.s: Juries were employed in trial, supplanting the older systems of trial by compurgation, ordeal, and combat.
compurgation.zh: 审判采用**陪审团**(jury)，取代**共誓涤罪**(compurgation)、**神明裁判**(ordeal)和决斗旧制。

ordeal.s: Juries were employed in trial, supplanting the older systems of trial by compurgation, ordeal, and combat.
ordeal.zh: 审判采用**陪审团**(jury)，取代**共誓涤罪**(compurgation)、**神明裁判**(ordeal)和决斗旧制。

wergild.s: The wergild, the fine, was divided among the king for the loss of a subject, the lord for the loss of a vassal, and the deceased's family.
wergild.zh: **血金**(wergild)即**罚金**(fine)，分给国王（失一臣民）、领主（失一封臣）和死者家属。

trial by combat.s: The Normans added the possibility of trial by combat, wherein one could either compete for oneself or hire a champion to engage in battle.
trial by combat.zh: 诺曼人增加了**决斗审判**(trial by combat)，可亲自上阵或雇斗士代战。

appellate.s: It exercised appellate jurisdiction over the Court of Common Pleas and over matters, including criminal matters, involving the king.
appellate.zh: 它对民诉法院行使上诉管辖权，并管辖涉国王的案件，包括刑事案件。

writ.s: The Chancery was headed by an official called a chancellor, usually a cleric, who was responsible for handling the government's paperwork, including the writs for courts.
writ.zh: **大法官署**(chancery)渐为各种法律上的不法行为发展出标准**令状**(writ)，但依**成文法**(statute)（1285年第二《威斯敏斯特条例》），**大法官署**(chancery)有权"由精通法律者创制**令状**(writ)，使法院将来不再久拖申诉不决"。

appellate jurisdiction.s: It exercised appellate jurisdiction over the Court of Common Pleas and over matters, including criminal matters, involving the king.
appellate jurisdiction.zh: 王座法院流动，最初随国王巡行乡间，对民事诉讼法院行使**上诉管辖权**(appellate jurisdiction)，也管涉国王事项包括刑事事项。

exchequer.s: The third court, the Exchequer, dealt primarily with matters of revenue and taxation.
exchequer.zh: 第三个法院即财政署，主要处理岁入与税收事务。

chancery.s: The Chancery was headed by an official called a chancellor, usually a cleric, who was responsible for handling the government's paperwork, including the writs for courts.
chancery.zh: **大法官署**(chancery)渐为各种法律上的不法行为发展出标准**令状**(writ)，但依**成文法**(statute)（1285年第二《威斯敏斯特条例》），**大法官署**(chancery)有权"由精通法律者创制**令状**(writ)，使法院将来不再久拖申诉不决"。

chancellor.s: At that time, the defendant would be placed under oath and questioned by the chancellor, who determined questions of both law and fact and then shaped a remedy.
chancellor.zh: **被告**(defendant)须**宣誓**(oath)接受**大法官**(chancellor)讯问，由其裁断法律事实问题，再量身**救济**(remedy)。

sheriff.s: This writ authorizes a sheriff or other law enforcement officer to seize the property or bank accounts of the defendant.
sheriff.zh: 该令状授权郡长或其他执法人员扣押被告的财产或银行账户。

specific relief.s: A court may award specific relief and substitutionary relief to a successful plaintiff.
specific relief.zh: 法院可判胜诉**原告**(plaintiff)**特定救济**(specific relief)和**替代救济**(substitutionary relief)。

substitutionary relief.s: Substitutionary relief, the basic common law remedy, generally refers to the award of money as compensation for a loss.
substitutionary relief.zh: **替代救济**(substitutionary relief)是基本**普通法**(common law)**救济**(remedy)，一般指判金钱补偿损失。

restoration.s: There are three general remedial goals in tort law: restoration to the status quo, compensation or indemnification, and punishment.
restoration.zh: **侵权法**(tort law)有三大救济目标：**恢复原状**(restoration)、补偿或赔偿、惩罚。

reliance.s: The reliance of judges on precedent and the doctrine of stare decisis remains as strong and viable as it was in the day of Henry II.
reliance.zh: 法官对先例的信赖和遵循先例原则，与亨利二世时代一样坚实有效。

administration.s: The administration of justice was primarily local.
administration.zh: 司法管理主要在地方层面进行。

magna carta.s: The Court notes that the idea of an impartial judiciary dates back to Magna Carta (1215).
magna carta.zh: 关于第7C(1)条是否促进重大州利益，法院认为州维护司法制度**正直**(integrity)的利益无疑达标：**公正司法**(impartial judiciary)理念可追溯至1215年《**大宪章**(magna carta)》。

freedom of speech.s: For example, he interpreted the First Amendment’s command that “Congress shall make no law” abridging freedom of speech to mean that all speech, even obscene speech, was protected.
freedom of speech.zh: 例如，他将**第一修正案**(first amendment)“国会不得制定法律”剥夺**言论自由**(freedom of speech)的命令，解释为一切言论、即使淫秽言论都受保护。

stare decisis.s: The doctrine of stare decisis, or following the precedent of prior court decisions, evolved through judicial custom.
stare decisis.zh: 遵循先例原则（stare decisis），即遵从先前法院判决中的**先例**(precedent)的原则，是通过司法惯例演变而来的。

adversarial system.s: Yet, the Anglo-American judicial system is based on the adversarial system, a system that is lawyer-centered in many ways.
adversarial system.zh: 盎格鲁-美国司法制度基于**对抗制**(adversarial system)，多方面以律师为中心。

case at bar.s: The procedure resembles that used by a judge in examining the pertinent precedent and applying it to the case at bar.
case at bar.zh: 程序类似法官审查相关**先例**(precedent)并用于**系争案件**(case at bar)。

liability.s: This simplifies the case for the jury, thus enabling them to concentrate solely on the issue of liability.
liability.zh: 这就为**陪审团**(jury)简化了案件，使其专注于**责任**(liability)问题。

barrister.s: Barristers are specialists who seldom have the right of direct access to the lay client and whose referrals come from solicitors.
barrister.zh: 两分支各由职业组织管理——**事务律师**(solicitor)归法律协会，**出庭律师**(barrister)归四大律师学院——管成员资格和成员纪律。

solicitor.s: Barristers are specialists who seldom have the right of direct access to the lay client and whose referrals come from solicitors.
solicitor.zh: 两分支各由职业组织管理——**事务律师**(solicitor)归法律协会，**出庭律师**(barrister)归四大律师学院——管成员资格和成员纪律。

bar association.s: The American Bar Association (ABA), a voluntary organization, plays an active role in the selection of federal judges, especially Supreme Court justices.
bar association.zh: 地方州全国各级**律师协会**(bar association)帮助统一美国**法律职业**(legal profession)。

disbarment.s: Violation of the code may lead to reprimands, temporary suspensions, or permanent disbarment of erring lawyers, depending on the severity of the breach.
disbarment.zh: 职业道德守则调整律师职业行为，违者依情节受谴责、暂时停业或永久**取消律师资格**(disbarment)。

mixed jurisdictions.s: William Tetley, "Mixed Jurisdictions: Common Law v. Civil Law (Codified and Uncodified)," 60 La.
mixed jurisdictions.zh: 威廉·泰特利，《**混合法域**(mixed jurisdictions)：**普通法**(common law)与**大陆法系**(civil law)（成文与不成文）》，《路易斯安那法律评论》60卷677页（2000年），第678页。

federal courts.s: Laws must be passed by Congress, signed and enforced by the president, and upheld by the federal courts.
federal courts.zh: 法律须国会通过、总统签署执行、联邦法院维持。

district court.s: U.S. district courts, U.S. courts of appeal, and the U.S. Supreme Court are examples of constitutional courts.
district court.zh: 美国地区法院、美国上诉法院和美国最高法院都是宪法法院的例子。

superior court.s: The superior court dismissed the case, and the Court of Appeals affirmed for lack of jurisdiction.
superior court.zh: 柯蒂斯·迪尔斯在工伤赔偿申请中称州劳工部错拒福利，且部似故意拖延终裁（作出即能上州法院**司法审查**(judicial review)），迪尔斯遂不等终裁直接诉**州高等法院**(superior court)求**确认性救济**(declaratory relief)，**州高等法院**(superior court)驳回，上诉法院以无**管辖权**(jurisdiction)维持。

courts of last resort.s: Most states have a single supreme court; two states, Oklahoma and Texas, have two courts of last resort: one for civil appeals and one for criminal appeals.
courts of last resort.zh: 大多数州只有一家最高法院；得克萨斯州则有两家**终审法院**(courts of last resort)：一家受理**民事上诉**(civil appeals)，一家受理**刑事上诉**(criminal appeals)。

punishment.s: Making the punishment, if any, fit the crime, then, is an important concern of criminal law and one that we will revisit with our case study at the end of the chapter.
punishment.zh: 因此，使**刑罚**(punishment)（如果有的话）与犯罪相适应，是**刑法**(criminal law)的一项重要关切，我们将在本章末尾的案例研究中再谈到这一点。

interpretations.s: Indeed, federal judges are required to respect the interpretations of state laws by state courts if there is not a federal question raised.
interpretations.zh: 事实上，若未提出联邦问题，联邦法官须尊重州法院对州法的**解释**(interpretations)。

rules of civil procedure.s: Under the rules of civil procedure, in order for the plaintiff to prevail, he must show that the weight, or preponderance, of evidence favors his version of the facts.
rules of civil procedure.zh: 根据民事诉讼规则，原告要胜诉，必须证明证据的分量即优势证据支持其主张的事实。

bar exams.s: Indeed, many states require lawyers from other states to pass their own bar exams, even though they were licensed to practice in their home states.
bar exams.zh: 事实上，许多州要求外州律师通过本州**律师资格考试**(bar exams)，即便他们已在家乡州**获准执业**(licensed to practice)。

licensed to practice.s: Indeed, many states require lawyers from other states to pass their own bar exams, even though they were licensed to practice in their home states.
licensed to practice.zh: 事实上，许多州要求外州律师通过本州**律师资格考试**(bar exams)，即便他们已在家乡州**获准执业**(licensed to practice)。

federal court system.s: The federal court system is characterized by two types of courts: constitutional and legislative.
federal court system.zh: 联邦法院系统的特点是存在两种法院：**宪法法院**(constitutional courts)与**立法法院**(legislative courts)。

constitutional courts.s: U.S. district courts, U.S. courts of appeal, and the U.S. Supreme Court are examples of constitutional courts.
constitutional courts.zh: 宪法法院有时被称为**第三条法院**(article iii courts)，系由宪法第三条设立的，该条授权国会“创建”低于**最高法院**(supreme court)的法院。

legislative courts.s: Legislative courts are also created by Congress, pursuant to one of its other legislative powers.
legislative courts.zh: 联邦法院系统的特点是存在两种法院：**宪法法院**(constitutional courts)与**立法法院**(legislative courts)。

article iii courts.s: The thirteenth court of appeals is the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit, which hears appeals from several Article III courts and a few commissions and agencies.
article iii courts.zh: 第十三家是**联邦巡回区美国上诉法院**(u.s. court of appeals for the federal circuit)，审理来自若干第三条法院及少数委员会和行政机关的上诉。

lifetime appointment.s: Judges who serve in the legislative courts do not have lifetime appointments, nor are their salaries protected as are those of Article III judges.
lifetime appointment.zh: 宪法还规定，最高法院和下级法院的法官“行为良好者得继续任职”，²这相当于**终身任职**(lifetime appointment)，只能经**弹劾程序**(impeachment process)予以**免职**(removal)。

impeachment process.s: The impeachment process must cover activities ranging from “partiality” to murder, with the same punishment for both.
impeachment process.zh: 第一，弹劾程序繁琐，尤其参议院审判阶段，参议院实际上可能被迫搁置其他立法等弹劾结果。

removal.s: Friends of the judge will usually suggest privately that it is time to resign or retire, but if the judge refuses, forced removal may be necessary.
removal.zh: 罢免年迈无能法官须谨慎：友人通常先私劝辞职退休，不从则须强制免职。

militia.s: Because of what the Court termed an atmosphere of “great hostility,” the local sheriff had to call in the state militia to protect the defendants.
militia.zh: 由于法院所说的“极度敌意”气氛，当地警长不得不召州民兵保护被告。

military tribunals.s: Under that authority, Congress may establish military tribunals for the purpose of disciplining soldiers.
military tribunals.zh: 根据该授权，国会可设立**军事法庭**(military tribunals)以惩戒士兵。

confirmation.s: Some Court watchers believe that another significant barrier was broken with the confirmation of Sotomayor as the nation’s first Latina justice to the Court.
confirmation.zh: 一些观察家认为索托马约尔作为首位拉丁裔大法官获确认打破了又一重大壁垒。

u.s. customs court.s: For example, in 1956, Congress changed the status of the U.S. Customs Court from a legislative to a constitutional court.
u.s. customs court.zh: 例如，1956年国会将**美国海关法院**(u.s. customs court)的地位由立法法院改为宪法法院。

courts of general jurisdiction.s: As most readers will be more familiar with the courts of general jurisdiction, we will begin our discussion of constitutional courts with them.
courts of general jurisdiction.zh: 鉴于多数读者更熟悉一般管辖权法院，我们先从这类法院谈起。

judicial power.s: Cases involving the state’s criminal laws, civil code, or state constitution fall within the judicial power of the state.
judicial power.zh: 一般管辖权法院有权审理落入州**一般司法权**(general judicial power)范围的任何案件，即有权对依州宪法和法律可司法解决的案件作出**裁断**(verdict)。

federal question.s: Indeed, federal judges are required to respect the interpretations of state laws by state courts if there is not a federal question raised.
federal question.zh: 除非州案提出**联邦问题**(federal question)或因其他原因落入联邦法院管辖权范围，州法院的**判决**(decisions)不受联邦法院**审查**(review)。

general jurisdiction.s: That is, a court of general jurisdiction has the authority to render a verdict in any case capable of judicial resolution under the constitution and laws of the state.
general jurisdiction.zh: 一般管辖权法院有权审理落入州**一般司法权**(general judicial power)范围的任何案件，即有权对依州宪法和法律可司法解决的案件作出**裁断**(verdict)。

senior judges.s: In addition to active federal judges there are retired judges, called senior judges, who hear cases on a part-time basis.
senior judges.zh: 除在职联邦法官外，还有被称为**资深法官**(senior judges)的退休法官兼职审案。

criminal jurisdiction.s: The criminal jurisdiction of these courts includes felony offenses.
criminal jurisdiction.zh: 此类法院的**刑事管辖权**(criminal jurisdiction)包括**重罪**(felony)。

civil jurisdiction.s: The U.S. district courts, the main trial courts for the United States, have both criminal and civil jurisdiction.
civil jurisdiction.zh: 地区法院是美国主要的**初审法院**(trial courts)，兼有**刑事管辖权**(criminal jurisdiction)和**民事管辖权**(civil jurisdiction)。

verdict.s: That is, a court of general jurisdiction has the authority to render a verdict in any case capable of judicial resolution under the constitution and laws of the state.
verdict.zh: 一般管辖权法院有权审理落入州**一般司法权**(general judicial power)范围的任何案件，即有权对依州宪法和法律可司法解决的案件作出**裁断**(verdict)。

review.s: The basis of the removal was improperly meeting with an attorney to review two of the attorney’s pending cases.
review.zh: 免职的理由是与一名律师不当会面，商讨该律师两起未决案件。

general appellate jurisdiction.s: The second tier of federal courts with general appellate jurisdiction consists of the U.S. courts of appeals.
general appellate jurisdiction.zh: 第二级是拥有**一般上诉管辖权**(general appellate jurisdiction)的联邦法院，即**美国上诉法院**(u.s. courts of appeals)。

u.s. courts of appeals.s: The second tier of federal courts with general appellate jurisdiction consists of the U.S. courts of appeals.
u.s. courts of appeals.zh: 例如，**第五巡回区美国上诉法院**(u.s. court of appeals for the fifth circuit)辖得克萨斯州、路易斯安那州和密西西比州，位于这些州的9家美国地区法院的**上诉**(appeal)均由其审理。

u.s. court of appeals for the federal ci.s: The thirteenth court of appeals is the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit, which hears appeals from several Article III courts and a few commissions and agencies.
u.s. court of appeals for the federal ci.zh: 第十三家是**联邦巡回区美国上诉法院**(u.s. court of appeals for the federal circuit)，审理来自若干第三条法院及少数委员会和行政机关的上诉。

substantive jurisdiction.s: Because U.S. courts of appeals hear only cases on appeal from U.S. district courts or federal regulatory agencies, they naturally have the same substantive jurisdiction.
substantive jurisdiction.zh: 因为美国上诉法院只审理来自美国地区法院或联邦监管机构的上诉案件，其**事项管辖权**(substantive jurisdiction)自然与之相同。

en banc.s: Occasionally, the court of appeals will decide to hear a case en banc, which simply means that all the judges assigned to that circuit will hear the case.
en banc.zh: 偶尔上诉法院会决定**全院庭审**(en banc)某案，即指派该巡回区全体法官审理。

jury trial.s: For example, in McKeiver v. Pennsylvania [136] the Court held that juveniles are not entitled to a jury trial.
jury trial.zh: 例如在**麦凯弗诉宾夕法尼亚州案**(mckeiver v. pennsylvania)[136]中，法院认定少年无权陪审团审判；又在**沙尔诉马丁案**(schall v. martin)[137]中维持纽约州允许审前羁押被指控失足少年的法律——格雷戈里·马丁被羁押15天，成人犯同样罪行可保释。

bench trial.s: The parties may choose to have a bench trial, in which the judge becomes the trier of fact while simultaneously acting as the interpreter of the law.
bench trial.zh: 当事人可选择**法官审判**(bench trial)，由法官兼任事实认定者与法律解释者；**证据**(evidence)提交后由法官一人断案。

courts of limited jurisdiction.s: County courts may also function as courts of appeal for lower courts of limited jurisdiction.
courts of limited jurisdiction.zh: 县法院还可充当下级有限管辖权法院的**上诉法院**(courts of appeal)。

justice of the peace court.s: A second common type of court of limited jurisdiction is the justice of the peace court.
